findings.evidence_source: activity.json runtime public tool inputs and outputs
findings.first_event_problem: start/end objects were accepted by the Mock and stringified to [object Object]; guests empty
findings.second_call_problem: passing the previous event id to createEvent created a different event rather than updating the first
findings.business_impact: An extra malformed calendar record may remain even if a required correct event exists. Original verifier and broader task trust assessment must be reported separately.
